title: Correct a failed shared plan check in its own plan
when: A shared deployment plan group failed because a check definition was wrong.
need: Edit the failed case in the group's own plan with the same case key, then rerun the same run, stage and plan without --replaces. Content refresh creates a replacement beside the failed history; its pass closes the group and credits its attachers. Pending and passed cases keep admitted content, and new keys wait for another release. Separate correction plans with --replaces are the single-member route. A group correction notice includes the plan; a stale pending case refusal names requirement inspection and supersession instead of an empty refresh command.
surface: Deployment plan execution guide and correction notices
review: Source regression proves same-plan failed-case correction and nonempty recovery; deployed proof remains owed.
